findings.claim: The deviation from the T9b row is sound. parentFills prepends from_role only when FromRole is empty and PayloadKind is roles.PayloadExemption. The only skeleton that leaves from_role empty is ExemptionHandoff. The record and verify skeletons still print reviewer, so their stderr is unchanged. Gating on kind avoids changing output nobody asked to change. The cost is a hidden coupling: a future skeleton that also leaves from_role empty must be added to this condition by hand.

evidence: Grepped the non-test callers of ExemptionHandoff, PayloadExemption and IsValidTransition in the worktree. SkipsReviewer is called only from checkTransition. IsValidTransition and NextRoles are unchanged. The only non-test callers of ExemptionHandoff are review/app/exempt.go and its definition.

SkipsReviewer requires ToRole delivery, a from_role that may hand off to the reviewer, a payload_kind of review-exemption and a completed status. The tests cover builder, sweeper and polisher accepted, and refuse an interrupted exemption, other kinds, estimator and shaper. Reviewer to delivery stays valid.
The chain test shows that from_role reviewer on an exemption is refused by chain continuity when the chain is at the sweeper, and that sweeper to delivery is stored.

I did not run any tests or commands. I did not read review/evidence.go or app/evidence.go beyond the grep lines, so whether an exemption record from builder, sweeper or polisher passes the delivery-side evidence check is not run.
